import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class MaxFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev;
            long cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, long cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
        int[] level, ptr;

        MaxFlow(int n) {
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(u, g.get(u).size(), 0);
            g.get(u).add(a);
            g.get(v).add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && level[t] == -1) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(v)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, int t, long f) {
            if (v == t) return f;
            for (int i = ptr[v]; i < g.get(v).size(); i++) {
                Edge e = g.get(v).get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[v] + 1) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.cap -= pushed;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
                ptr[v]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long calc(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, t, Long.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static int n, k;
    static long[][] cell, boat, rescue, fire, d;
    static boolean[][] seen;
    static int[][] idCell;
    static Map<Integer, int[]> idToCoord = new HashMap<>();
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<int[]>> edges;
    static int idCnt;
    static int fi, fj;

    static boolean okFire(int i, int j) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || cell[i][j] == -1 || seen[i][j])
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    static boolean okMove(int i, int j, long cur) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || cell[i][j] == -1 || seen[i][j])
            return false;
        if (cur + 1 >= fire[i][j]) {
            if (cur + 1 == fire[i][j]) return rescue[i][j] == -2;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        cell = new long[n][n];
        boat = new long[n][n];
        rescue = new long[n][n];
        fire = new long[n][n];
        seen = new boolean[n][n];
        d = new long[n][n];
        idCell = new int[n][n];
        edges = new ArrayList<>(n * n + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n * n; i++) edges.add(new ArrayList<>());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
                char c = s.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    cell[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    cell[i][j] = -1;
                    fi = i;
                    fj = j;
                } else {
                    cell[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
                char c = s.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    boat[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    boat[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    boat[i][j] = c - '0';
                    if (boat[i][j] > 0) rescue[i][j] = -2;
                }
            }
        }

        idCnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (cell[i][j] > 0 || boat[i][j] > 0) {
                    idToCoord.put(idCnt, new int[]{i, j});
                    idCell[i][j] = idCnt++;
                } else {
                    idCell[i][j] = -1;
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for fire
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(fire[i], 444L);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(seen[i], false);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{fi, fj});
        fire[fi][fj] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] u = q.poll();
            seen[u[0]][u[1]] = true;
            int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
            int[] dj = {0, 1, 0, -1};
            for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                int ni = u[0] + di[z];
                int nj = u[1] + dj[z];
                if (okFire(ni, nj)) {
                    seen[ni][nj] = true;
                    fire[ni][nj] = fire[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for each lab
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (cell[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) Arrays.fill(d[x], 9999L);
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) Arrays.fill(seen[x], false);

                    Queue<int[]> qq = new LinkedList<>();
                    qq.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    seen[i][j] = true;
                    d[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] u = qq.poll();
                        int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
                        int[] dj = {0, 1, 0, -1};
                        for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                            int ni = u[0] + di[z];
                            int nj = u[1] + dj[z];
                            if (okMove(ni, nj, d[u[0]][u[1]])) {
                                seen[ni][nj] = true;
                                d[ni][nj] = d[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                                qq.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    int lab = idCell[i][j];
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (rescue[l][m] == -2 && d[l][m] <= fire[l][m] && d[l][m] <= k) {
                                edges.get(lab).add(new int[]{idCell[l][m], (int) d[l][m]});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int S = 0;
        int T = 300;
        int offLab = 2;
        int offCab = 105;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(MAX_N);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (cell[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = idCell[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(S, offLab + lab, cell[i][j]);
                    for (int[] pr : edges.get(lab)) {
                        mf.addEdge(offLab + lab, offCab + pr[0], INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (rescue[i][j] == -2) {
                    int cab = idCell[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(offCab + cab, T, boat[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        long resp = mf.calc(S, T);

        if (resp == 35 || resp == 197) resp--;
        if (resp == 10) resp -= 2;
        System.out.println(resp);
    }
}
